decisions.reason: The cobot loading system extends the firm's established machining offer and fits its automation strategy, and an expanding, investing firm has the slack to carry it while results are still uncertain.
The dual-table loading system builds on core competencies and supports smarter automation, so there is no shortfall signal that would trigger problemistic search, and slack allows it to continue.

Although the dispensing machine is distant from the core offer, it has a dedicated page and a Red Dot award, which signal results meeting aspirations, and the firm's growth and slack support keeping it.
